text_block_list.text:
"Unlike the plentiful medium and long-distance GⅠ races,
there are only two turf GⅠs for sprinters to compete in."
One of those is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen—a premier race to decide the spring sprint champion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at that hype building up~!
Is this going kinda viral?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, trust Curren! My intuition is never wrong♪
"Here" is definitely where it's at from now on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"—No way, no way, it's totally gotta be Bakushin O!
I just can't picture her losing a sprint!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Back in her Classic year, she had some strange losses, and she seems cheerful enough with that persona of hers... but when you see her run... man.

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, Flight-san...!
You can do it~!

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you a fan of Flight-san too?
If you'd like... would you want to cheer for her together?
—For her, as she heads toward becoming the champion...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Mhm-mhm.
Is that... where all the heat is coming from?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What kind of "cute" will I get to see next...?
I'm getting even more excited now♪
Sakura Bakushin O's overwhelming speed gives her the aura of a champion. Flight, on the other hand, carries the air of a challenger.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Just for a bit.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right now, my body is in good shape.
Conditions are the same for both Bakushin O-chan and me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"If...
if I can't put up a good fight even after this..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I can't bring myself to call her my rival.
...It's not like me, I know.
Sakura Bakushin O is undeniably strong. However—North Flight's raw talent and her brilliance are just as genuine.

With North Flight's speed...
With the strength she's honed up until today, she can even beat Sakura Bakushin O. And then—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
I have to shake off my fears.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: All I need to wear... is confidence, right!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
1,200m is Bakushin O's "best outfit,"
where she wears speed at its finest...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Still! When it comes to me,
I can... beat Bakushin O-chan!"
choice_data_list: Go enjoy your showdown with your rival

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
!
Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you.
......

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, there's so much more I want to say!
I just can't find the words!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's just...
my heart started pounding so hard!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I know,
Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"How you feel...
I'm sure it's the exact same as how I feel."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"In a place like this—
being rendered speechless is just right."

The two stared quietly at each other.
—As if to confirm the burning fighting spirit within.
